heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S prints Polymaker PolyLite ABS reliably right out of the box thanks to its enclosed chassis, reaching safe speeds up to 214 mm/s bounded by an 18 mm³/s max volumetric flow. No nozzle or enclosure modifications are required, provided the chamber is kept closed and the bed is heated to 98°C to minimize thermal contraction.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with PVP glue stick or liquid adhesive as a release and bonding agent
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 18 mm³/s in filament settings with Nozzle Temperature at 255°C and Bed Temperature at 98°C.
Disable the Auxiliary Cooling Fan entirely (0%) and set the Chamber Exhaust Fan to 0% to retain heat and eliminate drafts.
Adjust Part Cooling Fan threshold to 0% min and 20% max, keeping the fan completely disabled for the first 3 layers.
Enable an outer brim with a 5mm to 8mm width and a 0.1mm brim-to-object gap to prevent corner lift on sharp geometry.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: High thermal shrinkage of ABS compounded by inadequate chamber heat soak or residue on the build plate.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Clean plate with warm soapy water, apply PVP glue, bump bed to 100°C, and let the bed heat-soak the closed enclosure for 15 minutes before starting.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive part cooling or low ambient chamber temp causing weak interlayer polymer diffusion.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Lower max cooling fan speed to 15%, set hotend temperature to 260°C, and ensure the auxiliary side fan is set to 0% in OrcaSlicer.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Moisture saturation in hygroscopic ABS filament or lack of wipe on travel moves.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the filament spool at 70°C for 6 hours in a dedicated filament dryer, and enable Wipe While Retracting (2mm) in extruder settings.

faq.question: Do I need to leave the door or top glass cracked when printing PolyLite ABS?
faq.answer: No, always keep the door and top lid fully closed to maintain high internal chamber temperatures and prevent warping.

faq.question: Is the stock stainless steel nozzle sufficient for Polymaker PolyLite ABS?
faq.answer: Yes, standard PolyLite ABS is non-abrasive, so the stock stainless steel 0.4mm nozzle will not experience premature wear.

faq.question: How can I ensure adequate chamber temperature on the P1S for ABS?
faq.answer: Preheat the bed to 100°C with the enclosure closed for 10 to 15 minutes prior to printing to passively bring the chamber up to ~40-45°C.

faq.question: What should I do if the AUX fan continues turning on automatically?
faq.answer: Edit the OrcaSlicer filament cooling profile and force the Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan speed to 0% for all print conditions.
